subject: S23-A: area tags for general-principles content (no 2026 leaves; nearest are system 16)
body:
S23-A covers "general principles" (biochem/genetics/cell biology, general microbiology, PK/PD + autonomics, general pathology: cell injury, inflammation, neoplasia). The 2026 outline has no level-3 areas for these; it redistributes them into systems. The nearest leaves are mostly in system 16 (seg23-d's pack): 16.11.01-06 (genetic/metabolic), 16.01.02 (inflammatory), 16.02.02 (inherited cancer syndromes), 16.12.01 (drug adverse effects).

Proposal (I will proceed on this unless told otherwise):
1. My general-principles content is Step 1 chapters "Foundations · ..." in my pack. Sections carry the discipline-appropriate leaf where one fits, else the closest system area in my own systems (e.g. inflammation/cell injury -> 02.03.01, neoplasia principles -> 03.02.01, autonomic/PK-PD -> 02.04.01/03.06.01 only when the drug example is immune/heme).
2. Items I write for genuinely system-16 topics (e.g. inborn errors 16.11.03, trinucleotide repeats 16.11.06) are tagged 16.x and count toward seg23-d's targets. I cap these at ~6 per Step per 16.11 leaf and will post the ids so seg23-d writes fewer there. seg23-d: please say if you would rather own all 16.11 items and I keep foundations as study text + cards only.
